note: Personalised shop welcome kit (owner brief 26-Nov-2026 10.50 IST; docs/shop-welcome-kit-2026-11, migration 0214). TC-WKIT-019…024 unit, 025…038 integration (real PostgreSQL); 032/034 also QA checks in tests/qa; SC-64 the end-to-end journey on test.gokesari.com.

features.feature: Personalised banner (owner line, 'This shop is now live on GoKesari.com', Order online + Pay here (UPI) QRs, optional uploaded payment QR) and e-mail (Dear <owner>, contact line, ASMY footer); every registration path; safety net; Resend updated banner; bulk to all live shops

scenarios.title: Every new shop gets one personalised welcome kit
scenarios.description: Whatever path makes a shop live, the owner gets one e-mail with banners carrying the shop and owner names and two QRs; existing shops get it by admin bulk send or resend.

cases.title: Owner line: printed only for a real name (no blank, null, placeholder or e-mail); capitals in title case
cases.steps: 1. Render the banner with owner names: blank, 'null', 'N/A', 'Owner', an e-mail, 'SUNITA RAMESH PATIL', a Devanagari name
cases.expected: No 'Owner:' line for the first five; 'Owner: Sunita Ramesh Patil'; the Devanagari name as typed

cases.title: UPI QR text: upi://pay with the shop's UPI ID, payee = shop name, no amount; uploaded QR checked
cases.steps:
1. Build the UPI QR from a UPI ID
2. Check an uploaded merchant QR, one with a fixed amount and a non-UPI QR
cases.expected: upi://pay?pa=<id>&pn=<shop>&cu=INR, no am=; the merchant QR is kept as is; fixed amount and non-UPI refused

cases.title: Both QRs (Order online, Pay here UPI) scan from a phone-size photo of the EN / MR / HI banner
cases.preconditions: A shop with a UPI ID
cases.steps:
1. Render each banner
2. Make a 1000-px blurred JPEG (phone photo)
3. Decode each QR
cases.expected: Shop QR → <site>/shops/<slug>; UPI QR → the upi://pay text, in all three languages

cases.title: No UPI panel without a UPI ID; the owner line only with a printable name
cases.steps: 1. Render without UPI ID and with an e-mail as owner name
cases.expected: Third feature column kept, no UPI QR; same image as with no owner name

cases.title: E-mail opens 'Dear <owner>, congratulations! <shop> is now live on GoKesari.com'; contact line; ASMY footer
cases.steps: 1. Build the welcome e-mail text and HTML
cases.expected: Opening as written ('Dear Shop Owner' without a name); support@gokesari.com and +91 91751 93009; last line 'gokesari.com is a unit of ASMY GLOBAL TRADING & CONSULTANCY INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED'; print instructions kept

cases.title: E-mail names the UPI QR, or tells the owner how to add a UPI ID in Settings
cases.steps: 1. Build the e-mail with and without a UPI ID
cases.expected: With: the UPI ID named; without: 'Seller Central → Accounts → Settings → UPI ID' and its link

cases.title: Admin 'mark as paid' → shop live → one personalised welcome e-mail
cases.preconditions: New shop, documents verified, auto-approve rule on
cases.steps:
1. Admin marks the registration fee paid (cash)
2. Outbox sweep
cases.expected: Shop APPROVED; one SHOP_WELCOME_KIT row; one e-mail to the owner with both PDFs

cases.title: Admin payment link paid (sandbox) → one welcome e-mail; a replayed capture adds none
cases.steps:
1. Admin creates a payment link
2. Pay it (sandbox success), twice
cases.expected: Shop APPROVED; exactly one welcome kit

cases.title: Dealer fee link (assisted registration) paid → one welcome e-mail
cases.preconditions: Assisted onboarding on; dealer's draft for the owner
cases.steps:
1. Dealer issues the fee link
2. Owner pays (sandbox)
cases.expected: Shop APPROVED; one welcome kit

cases.title: Automatic approval when the fee is recorded → one welcome e-mail
cases.steps: 1. Record the fee
cases.expected: Shop APPROVED; one welcome kit

cases.title: Queuing failure never blocks the approval; the safety net queues it later
cases.steps:
1. Approve
2. Run the safety net
cases.expected: Shop APPROVED; no row; the safety net queues one

cases.title: A failed send is retried with backoff and then sent once
cases.steps:
1. Sweep (fails)
2. Sweep after the wait
cases.expected: FAILED with next attempt later; then SENT; one e-mail

cases.title: Safety net: only shops live since the release without a kit; older shops never e-mailed; off switch
cases.steps:
1. One shop live before, one after
2. Run the safety net twice, then off
cases.expected: Only the newer shop queued, once; nothing when off

cases.title: Admin 'Resend updated banner': new banners, no second welcome, 10-minute guard, audited
cases.preconditions: Feature flag 'Send welcome kit to existing shops' on; a shop that had the kit
cases.steps:
1. Admin → Shops → Send welcome kit → search the shop → Resend updated banner
2. Press again at once
cases.expected: Updated-banner e-mail ('Dear <owner>, here are the updated GoKesari banners…') with both PDFs; second press refused; audit shop.banner_resent

cases.title: Bulk send to all live shops that never had the kit (≤ 200 per run)
cases.steps:
1. Tick 'All live shops' → Preview → tick owner knows → Send
2. Run again
cases.expected: Every live shop without a kit queued once; second run finds none

cases.title: Owner uploads the payment QR they use: UPI only, no fixed amount; banner prints it; remove falls back to UPI ID
cases.steps:
1. Seller Central → Marketing → Upload my payment QR (a non-UPI QR, a fixed-amount QR, a merchant UPI QR)
2. Remove it
cases.expected: First two refused with a clear message; the merchant QR saved and shown; after removal the banner uses the UPI ID from Settings

cases.title: Owner wizard + sandbox checkout → live → one welcome kit
cases.steps:
1. Register in the wizard
2. Pay (sandbox success)
cases.expected: Shop live; one welcome kit

cases.title: Staff registering on the owner's behalf, fee captured → one welcome kit (replay adds none)
cases.steps:
1. Operator registers with the owner's code
2. Fee captured, replayed
cases.expected: Shop live; one welcome kit

cases.title: Instant GST/PAN approval → one welcome kit
cases.steps:
1. Verify GSTIN/PAN
2. Pay online
cases.expected: Shop live; one welcome kit

cases.title: Paid self-registration (duplicate / concurrent webhooks) → one welcome kit
cases.steps:
1. Register and pay
2. Send the webhook 3× at once and again later
cases.expected: Shop approved once; one welcome kit

e2e.title: New shop (wizard, dealer link or admin on behalf) → sandbox fee → live → one personalised welcome e-mail → both QRs scan
e2e.journey:
1. Register a shop in the owner's wizard, through a dealer's fee link, and by an admin on the owner's behalf; pay each with the sandbox 'Pay (success)'
2. Each shop goes live
3. Read the testing inbox: one e-mail per shop, 'Dear <owner>, congratulations! <shop> is now live on GoKesari.com'
4. Open the EN and MR banners (HI for a shop outside Maharashtra): owner line, headline, Order online QR, Pay here (UPI) QR when the shop has a UPI ID
5. Scan both QRs with a phone
6. Admin: Resend updated banner for one shop; bulk send to all live shops
e2e.expected: One personalised e-mail per shop with both banners; the shop QR opens the shop (app when installed), the UPI QR opens a UPI app with the shop as payee and no amount; resend gives one updated-banner e-mail; bulk counts sent and skipped.
e2e.preconditions: test.gokesari.com, PAYMENT_GATEWAY=SANDBOX, mail redirected to the testing inbox, flag shop_welcome_kit_admin_send_enabled on.
